sentences.text: Author: Vivek Bharti Sharma Bench: Vivek Bharti Sharma

Office Notes, reports,
 orders or proceedings SL.
No.
 Date or directions and COURT'S OR JUDGE'S O  Registrar's order with  Signatures  10.06.2025 C-528 No. 787 of 2025  Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. Raj Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2.
Mr. Deepak Bisht, learned Deputy A.G. along with Mr. Prabhat Kandpal, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. Present petition is filed under Section 528 B.N.S.S. to quash the chargesheet,
cognizance/summoning order dated 24.01.2025 passed by learned 3rd Judicial Magistrate,
Dehradun in Criminal Case No. 675 of 2025 under Section 376 & 506 I.P.C. as well as the criminal proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner/accused would submit the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the instant crime; that, the alleged physical relationship between the petitioner and respondent no.2/complainant was wholly consensual and devoid of any coercion or deceit; that, FIR in question has been registered by respondent no.2/complainant with a view to exert undue pressure on the petitioner/accused and to settle personal scores and grudge.
5.
Issue notice to respondent no.2 through ordinary process and registered post acknowledgment due as well as through e-mail and whatsapp, if available.

6. Steps to be taken within two weeks.
7.

8. Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 675 of 2025 under Section 376 & 506 I.P.C. pending in the court of learned 3rd Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun shall remain stayed.
